what: Record of the test stage (PROTOCOL.json download, quality_checks, causality_test, scoring), in the order it ran, with the commits and the departures from the protocol's wording. results.json is the frozen score.py output, unchanged; it has no deviations field, so the departure after the download is recorded here and in source-verification.json.

sequence_utc.step: precondition: GitHub main equals the freeze commit; the protocol commit is its ancestor
download: manifest first (equal to its pin), then p014-p020 .dat/.hea and p001.dat/.hea, all equal to their pins
QC1-QC5 with the frozen qc.py on all 11 scored records; report sealed (SHA-256 recorded) before any forecast
causality test with the frozen causality.py, 200 cutoffs per scored record, replacement and truncation; zero changes; no target read
forecasts with the frozen forecast.py and weights for every arm at every scoring cutoff
lock committed (score_lock commit above) before any target was read
the one scoring run, frozen score.py in a separate process; it checked every lock hash before reading targets

departures.what: Download: PROTOCOL.json speaks of 17 requests. physionet.org answered each data-file request with an HTTP 302 redirect to PhysioNet's open-data bucket (physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com). The first run stopped at the first 302 (p014.dat) without following it; the download was resumed with redirects followed. 34 HTTP exchanges in all: 18 to physionet.org (p014.dat twice) and 16 redirected ones, one per data file.
departures.effect: None: every file equals its pin from the pinned manifest. No other file was requested.

not_needed: The QC1 rule for a missing or non-WFDB file (freeze review, first minor point): every pinned file was obtained and parsed, so no person needed it and the frozen qc.py ran on all 11 records.
not_opened: No .atr file was fetched or opened before results.json was written. The five subject 1-3 annotation files in the version 1 maintainer's copy (freeze review, second minor point) were not opened.
secondary_and_basal_source: p002 and p003 were read from b002.dat and b003.dat with the p002 and p003 headers, and b001 from its own files, in the version 1 maintainer's read-only copy; their SHA-256 values equal the pins (qc-report.json, QC1).

environment.threads: NumPy single-threaded (OMP, OpenBLAS and MKL threads 1); the causality test used 8 single-threaded worker processes; no GPU
